title: Grade 3 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #1

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected surah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Selected surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Selected surah has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on: responsibility? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: responsibility with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on: responsibility.
   C. Use Hadith on: responsibility to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on: responsibility has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Environment with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Environment has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment.
   D. Use Environment to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of.
   D. Say Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of care for plants? (1 mark)
   A. Say care for plants has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing care for plants.
   C. Use care for plants to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of care for plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on: Respect? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: Respect with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hadith on: Respect has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hadith on: Respect to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on: Respect.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Honesty? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:Honesty.
   B. Use Hadith on:Honesty to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on:Honesty has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Honesty with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

12. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick? (1 mark)
   A. Use Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick.
   C. Say Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain care for plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. B — Apply the teaching of Selected surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on: responsibility with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. A — Apply the teaching of Environment with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

6. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Apply the teaching of care for plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on: Respect with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Honesty with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

11. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

12. D — Apply the teaching of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Islamic; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Environment; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of care for plants; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
